events_rail.label: cash is at its lowest
events_rail.explain: This is the lowest point on your cash line: ¥300k, ¥0 above your minimum. Payroll of ¥200k takes cash from ¥500k to ¥300k. Without the financing plan, the lowest point would have been −¥50k in 4 days.

events_rail.label: Foshan pays
events_rail.explain: Foshan pays ¥420k, and ¥202k of it repays the invoice financing, leaving ¥218k. Cash rises from ¥300k to ¥418k, ¥118k above your minimum.

events_rail.label: debt service is paid
events_rail.explain: Cash falls from ¥418k to ¥373k. Your minimum is ¥300k, so ¥73k of room remains. Without the financing plan, debt service would have taken cash to ¥225k, below your minimum.
